source: Summarized by hand from the builder's progress log (kept outside this repository) on 2026-10-07. Each round was run by a fresh agent that read the code cold against docs/DESIGN.md (sections 5, 6, 7 and 12). Severity labels are the reviewer's. A count is given only where the log records one; the findings themselves are not reproduced here.

rounds.scope: get_farm_status and plan_feed (domain layer and the two tools)
rounds.fixed: all fixed with regression tests; a second pass resolved 11 of 13, then the 2 partial and 3 new Low were fixed too; one limit documented (top-level scoping of the status text)

rounds.scope: MCP App card and the Simulator (2026-09-27)
rounds.fixed: all fixed or documented; mutation check of the fixes 8 of 8

rounds.scope: farm profile, the confirmation pattern and the write path (2026-09-28)
rounds.fixed: all fixed with regression tests except two: a Simulator overlapping-turn race (fixed, reasoned only, not reproduced by a test) and a static help example on a contract farm (documented)
all fixed; the Critical one (a backdated correction could push the total deaths over the birds placed while saying it was saved) has a regression test
the High (contract mode leaked market-price rupee numbers into structured content) fixed with a regression test; the Info item documented as intended

rounds.scope: health triage and the vet handoff, first round (2026-09-29)

rounds.fixed: the High, both Medium and 3 Low fixed test-first; 4 Low deliberately not fixed, by the builder's decision

rounds.found: 2 High, 4 Medium, and Low items (the log names H1, H2, M1 to M4, L1 to L4)
rounds.fixed: H1, H2, M1, M2, M3 and L1 fixed; M4 only if its reproduction test failed; L2 to L4 deliberately not fixed

rounds.found: findings named B1, H1 to H4, M3, M5, M6, M8, L2 to L4 in the log; the full list is not copied here
rounds.fixed: B1, H1, H3, H4, H2, M5, M8, L2 and the first stage of M6 fixed (Steps 47A to 47C); M3 documented only; L3 and L4 cut by decision; the second stage of M6 became the structured safety field

rounds.found: the log does not record a count; the fixes fall into four groups: same-day deaths added or replaced silently, pilot access, the Telugu matcher and first-open notice, and operations files
rounds.fixed: fixed in Step 52 (four commits); the Telugu wording remains draft, and nothing was run on a server, a phone or a real browser
